# AGENTS.md

This project uses the RODO method (kit version in `rodo/.kit-version`).

1. Read `rodo/MAP.md`, then `rodo/MEMORY.md`, before anything else.
2. Then follow `.agents/skills/rodo/SKILL.md`. It tells you which playbook to open (planner, coder, onboarding, small-change, testing).
3. Every new feature, change or improvement gets a card in `rodo/cycles/`. Work from the card. Tiny changes that do not change behaviour need only one line in `rodo/CHANGELOG.md`.
4. Keep the project docs in `rodo/` true: when code changes what a doc says, update the doc.

Humans: read `rodo/RULES.md` (Persian).
